import paddle.nn as nn

    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()
        # Define the block
        self.block = nn.Sequential(

            nn.Flatten(),
            static.nn.fc(x=None, size=None, activation=None, name="fc1"), # Placeholder, size will be determined dynamically
            nn.Flatten(),
            static.nn.fc(x=None, size=None, activation=None, name="fc2") # Placeholder, size will be determined dynamically
        )

        # Define the two branches
        self.branch1 = self.block
        self.branch2 = self.block

        # Concatenate the outputs of the two branches
        self.concat = nn.Concat(axis=1)

        # Flatten the concatenated output
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()

        self.fc = static.nn.fc(x=None, size=10, activation=None, name="fc_out")

    def forward(self, x):
        # Pass the input through the two branches
        out1 = self.branch1(x)

        # Concatenate the outputs of the two branches
